title: Work order card at rest matches the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced, with Lead Technician, Service Advisor and Sales Representative {Sales-rep-A}; work order {Work-order-2} has nobody in Sales Representative.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001 and {Work-order-2} is S2-40002.
  • The design canvas is open in another tab at page 1, boards 1.2 and 1.5.
    For example: the canvas is https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-2} is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Without hovering, compare the Sales Representative field with board 1.2.
  2. Open {Work-order-1} and compare the card with board 1.5.
  3. Measure the gaps between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and Sales Representative (for example with the browser's ruler or a screenshot).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Sales Representative" on the first line and "Unassigned" on the second, in the same text style, size, weight and left edge as Lead Technician and Service Advisor; no box, no arrow and no button, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: the name {Sales-rep-A} on the second line, plain at rest, as in the picture.
  • Step 3: every gap is 16 px, including the gap under Lead Technician.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-R1, S1-R2, S1-R3, S1-R6, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, page 1, boards 1.2 and 1.5, used for the picture to compare against. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “The work order card shows a Sales Representative field directly under Service Advisor.”
  • S1-R2: “The field is the same field as Lead Technician and Service Advisor: the label "Sales Representative" sits inside it on the first line and the name on the second, in the same text style, size, weight and left edge.”
  • S1-R3: “At rest the field shows no box, no dropdown arrow and no buttons beside it.”
  • S1-R6: “The vertical gap between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and every Sales Representative field on the card is 16px. This holds with one field, with the Labor and Parts fields (S2-R5), and on the read-only card (S2-R17).”
